summary: @ornikar/repo-config preinstall executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package's preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs") runs an obfuscator.io-style renamed script that executes a bundled 727KB obfuscated file math_init.js under the Bun runtime. If bun is not present on PATH, setup.mjs downloads a Bun release zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line file using rotating string-array obfuscation (function WV8StW rotates array n7gIxM, indices resolved by hc1jfK9). The package is advertised as a lint-staged/prettier/commitlint repository configuration; executing an obfuscated payload under an alien runtime at install time is unrelated to that stated purpose. The alien-runtime execution path bypasses Node-based static analysis of the payload, and preinstall causes the code to run automatically on every `npm install` of this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
